# Airlock

| [![Stub](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/f/f1/Stub_v1.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/64?cb=20250514003444)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/f/f1/Stub_v1.png/revision/latest?cb=20250514003444) | *This article is a [stub](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Stubs). *You can help Us by [expanding it](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Airlock?action=edit). |
| --- | --- |

An Airlock is an entrance most used in submersibles which involve two door docks (or custom doors) and water pumps, when a player enters the airlock, they press a button to flood or dry an airlock and then open the door to go in or out of the vehicle.
